result.name: WALK
result.summary: Starts a first-person walkthrough of the 3D model.

result.name: WALL
result.summary: Draws a chain of joined walls (thickness, height, justification, type, arcs).

result.name: WALLTOP
result.summary: Sets the top constraint of walls (a level with offset, the next level, or an unconnected height) and their shape: elevation Profile or Gable, Slant, Taper, Reset.

result.name: WALLFLIP
result.summary: Flips walls: swaps the interior and exterior faces (layer order) keeping the wall, its openings and door swings in place.

result.name: WALLJOIN
result.summary: Joins wall ends that nearly meet (extends/trims them to their intersection).

result.name: WALLRECT
result.summary: Draws four joined walls around a rectangle (two corners; Justify sets whether the rectangle is the inside, centre or outside face).

result.name: WALLWRAP
result.summary: Wraps the finish layers of compound walls into door/window openings (all walls or selected walls) and around free wall Ends.

result.name: WALLSWEEP
result.summary: Adds cornices, skirting boards or string courses along wall faces, Reveals (grooves cut into the faces), or removes them.

result.name: WALLATTACH
result.summary: Attaches the top of walls to a roof or slab soffit, or the base to a slab top; Detach removes the attachment.

result.name: WALLBYLINES
result.summary: Converts selected lines, arcs, polylines, splines and ellipses into walls (curves become chains of arc walls).

result.name: WALLPOLYGON
result.summary: Draws a closed loop of joined walls: a regular polygon (centre, sides, radius), points, or a picked closed polyline.
